column1: # LI RE: test decisions (tools/make_debug_decisions.py) - delete with decisions/zz_li_debug_decisions.txt

column2: DEBUG: LI test mode: on
Shows the LI test decisions (resources, Roman tests). They have no AI and do nothing until taken.
DEBUG: LI test mode: off
Hides the LI test decisions again.
DEBUG: +1000 gold, prestige and piety
Enough to afford titles, claims and decisions.
An Eastern Roman successor exists (east_rome_lives)
A Western Roman successor exists (west_rome_lives)
The Roman Empire is restored (rome_restored)
My primary title is the Eastern successor
My primary title is the Western successor
My primary title has restored the Imperium (li_roman_imperium)
Last yearly count: half or more of my de jure empire is in my realm (li_imperium_share)
I have the Roman imperial government
My primary title has Imperial Elective
Provincia decisions are not collapsed
DEBUG: Roman status (hover)
Hover the allow list: green/red shows the Roman successor flags, government, succession law and provincia list state. Cannot be taken.
DEBUG: Restore the Imperium now

Byzantium / S.P.Q.R.: restores the Imperium at once (title flag, Imperial Elective, Roman imperial government), skipping the half-the-empire check. Anyone else just gets the government, which the game may switch back.
DEBUG: Make my empire the Eastern successor
Flags your primary title as the Eastern Roman successor and sets east_rome_lives, without the claim decision.
DEBUG: Make my empire the Western successor
Flags your primary title as the Western Roman successor and sets west_rome_lives, without the claim decision.
DEBUG: Clear all Roman successors
Removes both successor flags everywhere, so the claim decisions can be tested.
DEBUG: Show provincia shortcuts
Lists one shortcut per provincia that restores it at once, as if its decision had passed.
DEBUG: Hide provincia shortcuts
Hides the provincia shortcuts.
